title: harness/adapters/<name>/adapter.json: how the runner starts an adapter

mode.description: container: the runner builds and runs it in docker with only the brief and an output folder mounted; manual: a person files findings (human adapter)

build.description: Dockerfile path relative to the adapter folder (container mode)

network.description: episode: joins the episode's docker network and sees service URLs; host: sees ports published on the host (for systems that run outside docker)

env_passthrough.description: Host env vars passed in (e.g. an API token). Never printed

needs_approval.description: Why runs need an owner's go-ahead (e.g. hosted spend)
